must_identify.item: New api pods are stuck in Init:0/1 because the init container wait-for-db never completes
must_identify.evidence: The new pod api-77b4b6956f-qrdkb is stuck at Init:0/1 on node acme-lab-worker2, looping waiting for postgres:5432 indefinitely since the DNS name never resolves/connects.

must_identify.item: It waits for postgres:5432, and no Service named postgres exists in namespace shop
must_identify.evidence: Effect: namespace shop has no postgres Service, Deployment, StatefulSet, or Pod — only api, frontend, redis.

notes: The RCA lists deploying Postgres as option 1. It is conditioned on the app needing Postgres, and the RCA states the api code only talks to Redis, so it does not match the wrong answer of creating a database without noting the api does not need one. The other options offered, removing the init container and rolling back, are both acceptable fixes.
